description: This file defines a React Native component named VideoPlayer that renders a customizable video player with controls such as play/pause, seek, and fullscreen. It handles video source validation, buffering states, and error conditions, and uses expo-av's Video component for playback.

methods.name: VideoPlayer
methods.description: Main functional component that renders the video player UI with controls, manages playback state, and handles user interactions.

methods.name: handlePlaybackStatusUpdate
methods.description: Updates component state based on the Video's playback status, manages loading indicator and error states.

methods.name: togglePlayPause
methods.description: Toggles video playback between play and pause states.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks the video forward or backward by a given delta in milliseconds.

methods.name: handleFullscreen
methods.description: Attempts to set the video into fullscreen mode.

methods.name: renderControls
methods.description: Renders the playback control buttons (rewind, play/pause, forward, fullscreen).
